* When the target has more than one permanent pilot, the 2002 supplement removes all permanent pilots.<ref>[[:File:Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf|Glossary Supplement]], page 2.</ref>
|notes=* Decipher published this errata as text only, in the [[Media:Decipher_Glossary_1998.pdf|Glossary Version 2.0]] (November 1998). The main image is that entry. Printed face: [[Come With Me]]. Side-by-side faces: [[Errata]].

Decipher's own errata for this card, published as text only in the Glossary Version 2.0 (November 1998). Decipher also printed these words on its white-bordered [[Come With Me (Revised)]] (September 1998), before the Glossary.
